name: Pony.ai
sub: Robotaxi & passenger L4; Autonomous trucking L4
regions: China; US testing history; international exploration
leadership: James Peng, co-founder and CEO; Tiancheng Lou, CTO
about: Chinese AV company spanning robotaxi and trucking. Pony.ai is one of the few public pure-play AV operators with meaningful Chinese deployment and Toyota / GAC ties. Runs a multi-sensor (lidar + camera) stack with a hybrid HD-map / light-map approach that can bootstrap a new city from navigation maps alone, and is shifting from rule-based planning toward a hybrid rule-based + end-to-end architecture.
model: Robotaxi fares; autonomous trucking; technology licensing
financing: Public (Nasdaq: PONY); $413M raised in the 2024 US IPO and placements, plus ~$860M gross in the November 2025 Hong Kong dual-primary listing
deployment: Beijing, Guangzhou, Shenzhen and Shanghai operations across northern, central and southern China's full weather range; truck testing on China freight lanes; overseas robotaxi entries across the Middle East, Singapore, South Korea and Europe; US presence refocused on R&D.
metrics: Fleet passed 1,700 robotaxis (May 2026); year-end 2026 target raised to 3,500+; first profitable quarter in Q4 2025 ($75.5M net income, driven mainly by an investment gain); Q1 2026 robotaxi revenue up 395% YoY; Gen-7 kit cut autonomy BOM about 70%, targeting all-in vehicle cost below ~RMB 230,000.
signal: Unit-economics breakeven in Shenzhen and Guangzhou; citywide Shenzhen driverless permit with taxi operator Xihu Group; 1,000+ Toyota bZ4X-based robotaxis planned for 2026; China's first unmanned-cargo truck-platoon permit.

sources.title: Pony AI Q1 2026 results: fleet passes 1,700 robotaxis, year-end target raised to 3,500+
